question: Who is remembered as 'Deshbandhu', who served as the President of the Indian National Congress for one session in 1922 and co-founded the Swaraj Party with Motilal Nehru?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chittaranjan Das**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chittaranjan Das** is remembered as 'Deshbandhu'.
 
• He served as the President of the Indian National Congress for one session in 1922.
 
• He co-founded the Swaraj Party with **Motilal Nehru**.
 
• Chittaranjan Das played a significant role in the Indian freedom struggle and was an influential leader of his time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chittaranjan Das was a prominent lawyer and political leader.
 
• He was known for his defense of Aurobindo Ghosh in the Alipore Bomb Case.
 
• He was a key figure in the Non-Cooperation Movement led by Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• Das's contributions to the freedom struggle were not only political but also social and educational.
 
• His efforts laid the groundwork for future political movements and parties in India.
